items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Shripman used to put us on, used to have every once a week, or every two or three weeks, he'd put us in a ballroom like down in Connecticut.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Glenn Miller?

No, I was supposed to go with him -- I was just getting to that before. And then there was Bunny Berigan. Shripman used to put us on, used to have every once a week, or every two or three weeks, he'd put us in a ballroom like down in Connecticut.
Now wait, you say 'us' -- who was 'us', Cliff?
